EvidenceBody: In Chan records this phrase is the title and shorthand of a public case built around Wuzu Fayan's question: Qiannu's soul departed—which one is real? Wumen preserves the question and warns against running about wildly in his comment. Fojian Huiqin repeatedly presses Cishou Huaishen with the case until the record says an obstruction opened. Fuyan Ya discusses it with a lay official and warns him not to fasten onto Qiannu. Xueguan Zhiyin keeps the case open through its own alternatives: whether she is karmic consciousness or mind-born, and whether one or two; his answer says there is no need to display form and shadow. Chaozong Tongren answers the real-one question with two strikes and a warning against eloping. Baishan Dekai answers a layperson's version with ‘where money was lost in the river, dredge in the river.’ The tale-name has become a compact, repeatedly interviewed case formula. The entry reports the questions and answers without selecting a real Qiannu for them.
